detail.reason: Planner-performed replan (proactive, no executor escalation): the approved plan committed the vite ^8.3.0 bump in upgrade-baseline while no state owned the fix that makes it safe. Verified: (a) Vite 8/Rolldown lowers import.meta.url to {}.url in browser-platform cjs output, so every built CJS entrypoint throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE at module load (measured apigen-cli:test 188 pass on vite 6.4.3 -> 26 failed on 8.3.0); (b) packages/ui-react/ui-react-base-hooks is public and cannot build at all under the branch's @types/react 19 bump (4 TS errors, no dist emitted) and its CJS/UMD bundles carry the same token. Added three states (vite-cjs-import-meta-repair, browser-package-build-repair, browser-cjs-umd-repair), moved the bump commit out of upgrade-baseline into vite-cjs-import-meta-repair so bump and fix are one commit (guard asserts same-commit-SHA atomicity AND executes the built artifacts), re-pointed gate-triage-absorbed's inbound edge, and added dod.14/dod.15 with 22 criteria. Five original goals unchanged; all pre-existing states untouched apart from that one edge.

./node_modules/.bin/nx build ui-react-base-hooks && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config packages/ui-react/ui-react-base-hooks/vite.config.ts packages/ui-react/ui-react-base-hooks/src/lib/use-file-download/import-meta-url.spec.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['packages/ui-react/ui-react-base-hooks/dist/index.js','packages/ui-react/ui-react-base-hooks/dist/index.umd.js']){const t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(t.includes('{}.url')){console.error('EMPTY_IMPORT_META_URL in '+f);process.exit(1)}if(t.includes('__filename')||t.includes('node:url')){console.error('NODE_SHIM_IN_BROWSER_BUNDLE in '+f);process.exit(1)}}console.log('BROWSER_BUNDLES_CLEAN')"
